name: Terrarium 60x30x25
label: Medium terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 60x30x25 cm. Volume: 45.0 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: The 60x30x25 cm terrarium is low and elongated: a floor of 1800 cm², 25 cm of height and 45 liters of volume. It has no 3D background, and we cover the outer sides with a film of your choice. Thanks to its 30 cm width it fits on most shelves and dressers. Access is from the front, through sliding glass.

These dimensions suit young animals. A young ball python feels safer in a low, easily surveyed space than in a large terrarium, and 60 cm of length is enough for a warm and a cool hide. Young tortoises and a young blue-tongued skink use the whole floor. Adults of these species, as well as an adult bearded dragon, need a considerably larger floor.

The model five centimeters taller with the same floor is the 60x30x30, and the wider one is the 60x40x30. When the animal grows, the next step is terrariums 80 to 100 cm long. If you need a special size, we build it in 7 to 14 days. This model gets film on three sides, in one of 34 patterns.
